items.label: 【4 piece Patio Furniture Covers】
items.value: The 4-piece outdoor furniture cover includes 1 x loveseat cover, 1 x coffee table cover, and 2 x patio chair covers, suitable for use in the living room, courtyard, balcony patio furniture.

items.label: 【Dimensions】
items.value: Loveseat cover : 56"L*30"W*30"H/24", patio chair covers : 32"L*30"W*30"H/24", coffee table cover : 45"L*25"W*13"H. Warm Tips: The size is only cover size, please measure the dimensions carefully before purchasing, recommend choosing a cover 2 inches larger than your furniture.

items.label: 【Premium Waterproof】
items.value: Our Outdoor Furniture Covers is made of Heavy duty 420D oxford polyester fabric, Inner is designed with PU waterproof coating and waterproof tape at the seams to protect your furniture from wind, rain, snowstorm, fallen leaves, dirt, dust, or bird droppings.

items.label: 【Windproof Design】
items.value: 4 windproof buckles and 2 elastic hem cords with adjustable toggles allow the cover to make a tight custom fit on the bottom of the furniture covers, it will not be blown away by the heavy wind.

items.label: 【Easy to Use and Clean】
items.value: Easy to install and remove, suitable for both outdoor and indoor use. The Oxford fabric is easy to clean, just wipe it clean with a damp rag when it gets dirty.
